text: Program Objectives Designed to meet the needs of international hotel industry, this BSc program gives the students both in-depth knowledge in hotel management and a broader range of transferable skills that can be applied to a variety of hotel supervisory and managerial roles. Main Courses Hotel Operation and Management; Food & Beverage Operation and Management; Rooms Division Operation and Management; Hotel Human Resource Management; Hotel Facilities Management; Hotel Accounting Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree
